scenario: During inventory generation a dependency's version is unreadable; a model offers a remembered version. The inventory records an unknown, never the model's guess — and enrichment stays in its own non-authoritative fields.

reasons: parser-lib appears with its inspected version and source
legacy-blob appears with version recorded as unknown and a finding to resolve it
the model's description enrichment sits in enrichment fields, labeled non-authoritative
must_not: record 2.7 or any model-remembered version as legacy-blob's version
omit legacy-blob to keep the inventory tidy
let enrichment overwrite any authoritative field
